equipment: none
p2: Same woman facing the camera. Her legs are now CROSSED: the foot that was behind has stepped across BEHIND the other leg and landed on the far side of it, so seen from the front her shins form a clear X with the back foot visibly on the opposite side of the front foot
paintOn: the outer hips and inner thighs of both legs

equipment: a plain dark grey exercise mat only, no other equipment
p2: Wide stance with both legs straight; torso folded forward and TWISTED so the hand OPPOSITE the front leg is planted on the floor on the outside of the front foot, the other arm points straight up at the ceiling, chest turned to face sideways
primary: Hamstrings of the front leg and obliques
paintOn: the back of the front thigh and the side of the waist
poseRefNote: the photo shows the twisted end pose

equipment: a plain dark grey exercise mat only, no other equipment
p2: Still lying flat on her back with arms on the mat. Both legs stay STRAIGHT and pressed together but are now LOWERED to about 45 degrees and swung toward the camera side, so her feet hang in the air about a forearm-length above the mat beside her hips; the legs do NOT lie on the mat
paintOn: the side of the waist
muscleSource: Standard Pilates mat exercise (Joseph Pilates' Return to Life)

equipment: a plain dark grey exercise mat only, no other equipment
p2: Both hands flat on the floor beside her waist, arms straight, shoulders leaning far forward over the hands, and BOTH feet lifted clear off the floor with the knees tucked up under her chest - her whole body balanced on her hands, nothing else touching the floor
paintOn: the front of both shoulders and the chest

equipment: a plain dark grey exercise mat only, no other equipment
p2: Same seat, feet flat, but her torso now LEANS BACK about 45 degrees behind upright with the whole back rounded into a C-shape, chin tucked, arms still reaching forward - clearly further back than the start
paintOn: the abdomen

equipment: a plain dark grey exercise mat only, no other equipment
p2: Still squatting deep on her toes, but her torso has TURNED 90 degrees so her chest faces sideways, and BOTH palms are planted flat on the floor beside the OUTSIDE of one knee, that knee pressing into her upper arm
paintOn: the side of the waist

equipment: none
p2: Standing fully tall with straight legs, up on TIPTOES: the balls of both feet and the toes stay ON the floor, both HEELS lifted high off the floor with a clear gap under each heel; arms straight forward. Her feet are not in the air
paintOn: the front of both thighs, both buttocks and both calves

equipment: one horizontal rail she holds with both hands
p2: Standing on ONE leg holding the rail, the other ankle resting ACROSS the top of the standing knee so that leg forms a figure 4, the hips sat far back and down as if sitting on a chair
primary: Gluteus maximus and piriformis of the crossed leg (lengthened)
paintOn: the buttock of the crossed leg

equipment: a plain dark grey exercise mat only, no other equipment
p2: Same position with one leg straight out to the side, but her hips have rocked far BACK toward the heel of the kneeling leg, buttocks low near that heel, arms straight, the inner thigh of the straight leg stretched
paintOn: the inner thigh of the straight side leg

equipment: a plain dark grey exercise mat only, no other equipment
p2: STILL in child's pose: kneeling with her hips resting back on her heels and her forehead low near the mat, both arms stretched along the mat, but both hands have walked far over to one side so her torso curves sideways like a banana. She is NOT sitting upright
paintOn: the side of the ribs and waist that faces up

equipment: a plain dark grey exercise mat only, no other equipment
p2: Same seated pike with straight legs together and hands on the mat beside her knees, but BOTH straight legs are lifted off the mat with a clear gap and shadow between her heels and the mat
paintOn: the front of both hips and upper thighs

equipment: a plain dark grey exercise mat only, no other equipment
p1: Sitting with her buttocks ON the mat (not kneeling, not lunging): the front leg's thigh points straight ahead with that shin lying flat on the mat across in front of her body; the back leg's thigh points out to the side with that shin pointing straight back; both knees bent at right angles and both legs lying flat on the mat in a zig-zag; torso upright, fingertips on the mat
p2: Same 90/90 legs, she leans her straight torso forward over the front shin, chest toward that shin, hands on the mat in front
primary: Gluteus maximus and hip external rotators of the front leg (lengthened)
paintOn: the outer hip and buttock of the front leg
poseRefNote: the photo shows the 90/90 seated leg position

equipment: a mat and a small pillow under her head
p1: Lying on her SIDE (not on her back), body facing the camera, bottom shoulder and bottom arm on the mat, head on a small pillow; her bottom upper arm sticks straight out in front of her chest along the mat, elbow bent 90 degrees so that forearm points straight UP at the ceiling; her top hand holds that bottom wrist; legs stacked and bent
p2: Same position; her top hand has gently pressed the bottom forearm forward and down so it now lies flat toward the mat in front of her waist, the bottom elbow still at shoulder height
primary: Posterior shoulder (infraspinatus, teres minor) of the bottom arm (lengthened)
paintOn: the back of the bottom shoulder
muscleSource: McClure et al. 2007 (sleeper stretch, posterior shoulder)

equipment: a plain dark grey exercise mat only, no other equipment
p1: On her forearms and knees, the knees spread EXTREMELY wide to the sides (about twice hip width), shins pointing straight back parallel to each other, feet turned out, hips level with the knees; camera slightly behind and above so the wide knees are clearly visible
p2: Same very wide knees, she has lowered onto her forearms and pushed her hips back toward her heels so her inner thighs sink close to the mat
paintOn: the inner thighs of both legs

equipment: a plain dark grey exercise mat only, no other equipment
p1: High plank on her toes with straight arms, but her HANDS are placed far back on the mat level with her HIPS (not under her shoulders), fingers turned out sideways, so her shoulders are far in front of her hands and her body leans forward over them
p2: Same hand position beside her waist, elbows bent and tucked back along her ribs, chest lowered close to the mat, shoulders still in front of her hands
paintOn: the front of both shoulders and the chest

equipment: exactly ONE light dumbbell in one hand; a flat bench
p1: Seated on the bench end, the forearm resting flat along the top of his thigh with the hand hanging over the knee, PALM FACING DOWN gripping the dumbbell, the wrist bent DOWN so his knuckles point at the floor
p2: Exactly the same arm position, forearm still flat on the thigh - only the WRIST has bent upward so the back of the hand and the dumbbell are raised above the forearm; the elbow and forearm have not moved
paintOn: the top of the working forearm

equipment: exactly TWO gymnastic rings hanging on straps
p1: Suspended above the floor: she grips two gymnastic rings beside her hips with arms locked straight DOWN, pushing herself up so her hips are level with the rings; knees bent and feet tucked back so her feet are well ABOVE the floor; the straps run up out of frame
paintOn: the back of both upper arms and the chest

equipment: none
p1: Split stance on the balls of both feet, one foot forward and one back, knees almost straight, arms at her sides
p2: Bounced up with BOTH feet clearly off the floor (visible gap and shadow), legs having switched mid-air so the other foot is now in front
paintOn: the back of both lower legs

equipment: a plain dark grey exercise mat only, no other equipment
p1: Lying face down, forehead just off the mat, both straight arms raised off the floor overhead in a Y shape, thumbs up
p2: Same, but both straight arms are now out to the sides at shoulder height in a T shape, lifted off the mat, thumbs up
paintOn: the upper back between and below the shoulder blades
muscleSource: Standard Y-T-W scapular exercise (Y and T positions)

equipment: none
p1: Standing, one arm straight in front at shoulder height, palm facing AWAY, fingers pointing up; the other hand gently pulls those fingers back toward her
p2: Same straight arm, now palm facing her body with fingers pointing DOWN; the other hand gently presses the back of that hand toward her
paintOn: the forearm of the straight arm

equipment: none
p1: Seated on a chair, one hand raised in front of her face, palm toward the camera, fingers spread; the thumb touching the tip of the index finger
p2: Same raised hand, now the thumb touching the tip of the little finger, the other fingers straight
paintOn: the forearm of the raised hand

equipment: a plain dark grey exercise mat only, no other equipment
p1: Sitting tall on the mat, legs straight together in front with feet flexed, both arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height, chest facing straight ahead over the legs
p2: Same legs and arms, her upper body has twisted 90 degrees to one side so one arm points forward over her legs and the other points behind her; hips have not moved
paintOn: the side of the waist

equipment: a plain dark grey exercise mat only, no other equipment
p1: Sitting tall, legs straight and wider than hip-width apart, feet flexed, arms straight forward at shoulder height
p2: Same legs, she has rounded her spine forward vertebra by vertebra, head dropped, hands reaching forward along the mat between her legs toward the feet
paintOn: the back of the torso

equipment: a plain dark grey exercise mat only, no other equipment
p1: Low lunge: front foot flat with the knee over the ankle, back knee down on the mat, both hands planted on the mat INSIDE the front foot, hips square
p2: Same lunge, she has lowered both FOREARMS onto the mat inside the front foot, hips sinking lower toward the mat
primary: Hip flexors of the back leg and adductors of the front leg (lengthened)
paintOn: the front of the hip of the back leg
doNotPaint: arms, front of the front thigh

equipment: a plain dark grey exercise mat only, no other equipment
p1: Deep yoga garland squat: buttocks very low, almost touching the mat and well BELOW the knees, feet wider than hips with toes out and heels flat, torso upright, palms pressed together at the chest with elbows pushing the inner knees outward
paintOn: the inner thighs

equipment: exactly ONE dumbbell, held in one hand; the other hand empty on his hip
p1: Standing tall, the dumbbell held at the shoulder with the elbow bent, both feet on the floor
p2: The arm holding the dumbbell pressed straight overhead, and the knee on the SAME side as the empty hand driven up to hip height. Red tint ONLY on the shoulder of the arm holding the dumbbell; NO red on the other shoulder
primary: Anterior deltoid of the arm holding the dumbbell
paintOn: the shoulder of the arm holding the dumbbell ONLY
doNotPaint: the shoulder of the empty-handed arm, legs

equipment: one small loop band around both ankles; a mat
p1: Lying on her back, hands under her hips, both legs straight and lifted a hand-width off the mat, a loop band around the ankles; the near leg slightly higher than the far leg
p2: Same, but the legs have swapped: the far leg is now higher and the near leg lower, band stretched
paintOn: the front of both hips and the lower abdomen

equipment: one resistance band anchored low in front of her; a mat
p1: Straight-arm plank on her toes, the band handle held in the hand nearest the camera, that hand on the mat under the shoulder
p2: Same plank, the arm holding the band now reaches straight forward at shoulder height, band stretched, body still level
paintOn: the abdomen and the shoulder of the reaching arm

equipment: one resistance band anchored low to the side; a mat
p1: Straight-arm plank on her toes, the band handle held in the hand nearest the camera, that hand on the mat under the shoulder
p2: Same plank, the arm holding the band pulled straight out wide to the side at shoulder height, band stretched, hips level
paintOn: the back of the shoulder of the pulling arm and the abdomen

equipment: one resistance band anchored at chest height to her side
p1: Half-kneeling side-on to the anchor, both straight arms holding the band handle in front of her chest pointing toward the anchor
p2: Same kneel, her upper body has rotated away from the anchor so both straight arms point to the far side, band stretched across her body; hips do not move
paintOn: the side of the waist

equipment: one flat bench behind her
p1: Bulgarian split squat: back foot laces-down on the bench, front knee bent about 90 degrees, back knee lowered toward the floor, arms back
p2: Exploded up off the front leg: the front foot clearly OFF the floor with a visible gap and shadow, front leg straight, back foot still on the bench, arms swung up
primary: Quadriceps and glutes of the front leg
paintOn: the front of the thigh and the buttock of the front leg

equipment: one resistance band looped around both feet and anchored behind her; a mat
p1: Kneeling on all fours with the knees just behind the hips, back rounded, band from her feet running taut to the anchor behind
p2: Same hands, she has pushed both knees back a hand-width against the band, knees still just off the mat, back still rounded
paintOn: the abdomen and both buttocks
muscleSource: Pilates reformer knee stretch, mat-with-band version

equipment: one resistance band under both hands, ends held; a mat
p1: Straight-arm plank on her toes, shoulders directly above the wrists
p2: Same straight-arm plank, the whole body shifted forward so the shoulders are well in front of the wrists, body still one straight line
paintOn: the abdomen and the front of both shoulders

equipment: one resistance band around both feet; a mat
p1: Lying on her back, knees bent, feet flat on the band, hips lifted into a bridge
p2: Same feet, she has lowered her spine to the mat and straightened her legs forward, hips low, band taut
paintOn: both buttocks and the back of both thighs

equipment: one loop band around both ankles
p1: Standing facing the camera, feet hip-width apart, band around the ankles, hands on hips
p2: Same, the feet now pressed far apart sideways in a wide straddle, band stretched taut, legs straight
paintOn: the outer hips of both legs
muscleSource: Pilates reformer side splits, standing band version

equipment: a plain dark grey exercise mat only, no other equipment
p1: Lying on her side, both legs straight, head resting on the bottom arm
p2: Same side-lying, the top knee pulled up toward her chest with the top hand holding it, bottom leg straight
primary: Gluteus maximus of the top leg (lengthened)
paintOn: the buttock of the top leg

equipment: exactly ONE foam roller; a mat
p1: Seated on the mat leaning back on her hands, legs straight, the foam roller under the top of both calves just below the knees, hips lifted off the mat
p2: Same, she has rolled forward so the roller is now just above her ankles
paintOn: the back of both lower legs
